entries.description: Reviewed the accepted app-proof and multi-organization baselines, the completed E2E design artifacts, the current Playwright and web guardrail proof surfaces, and the remaining downstream Phase 2 specs through a routed analysis pass to confirm that the e2e-workflow-implementation set still matches the current queue and proof posture.

Created docs/planning/e2e-playwright-fixture-strategy.md to freeze the shared PlaywrightFixture-first harness strategy, the reset and cleanup posture, persona ownership, selector discipline, and the WF-04 then WF-05 initial implementation slice for Session 2.

Created docs/planning/e2e-workflow-implementation-review-ledger.md and used the fixture strategy to lock the browser-first backend-truth verification pattern, current browser-proof baseline, implementation guardrails, and the no-downstream-spec-change verdict for Session 1.

Updated docs/session-sets/e2e-workflow-implementation/spec.md to record that no downstream Phase 2 session set is safe to overlap with this implementation set and that only disjoint intra-set workflow files become safe to parallelize after the shared harness, reset helpers, persona fixtures, and backend-truth pattern are frozen.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln. The solution build succeeded with the existing preview-SDK notice and one nullable warning in WebGuardrailTests. The full test run still reproduced the current HTTP 500 baseline failures in AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests on HomePage_RendersInsideMainShellAndIncludesDabblerAssetAsync, BackofficeAdmin_RouteAccess_MatchesFocusedAdminNavigationAsync, SystemAdmin_RouteAccess_IncludesSystemAdminDestinationsAsync, and AuthenticatedOrganizationSwitch_UpdatesShellAndAdminScopeAsync, plus matching AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright smoke failures on HomePage_ShowsApiConnectivityAsync, MagicLinkFlow_SignsInRetailBusinessUserAndLoadsOrdersAsync, SeededSession_EnforcesPermissionsAndRetailBusinessOrderScopingAsync, and AdminNavigation_UsesFocusedProductsEntryAndActualRolePermissionsAsync rather than exposing a Session 1 planning-doc regression.

Ran mandatory external session verification for Session 1 using the Session 1 spec, the new review-ledger and fixture-strategy artifacts, the updated activity log, and the build/test evidence, then saved the raw verifier output and received a VERIFIED verdict on the first round.

Extended tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright/Infrastructure/PlaywrightFixture.cs with reusable admin-products navigation, exact-name product lookup, product-by-id reads, archive cleanup helpers, and availability-restore helpers so Session 2 workflows can prove browser actions against narrow backend truth without duplicating setup code.

Updated src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web/Components/Layout/MainLayout.razor, src/Libs/Dabbler.Security.Blazor/Extensions/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs, src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web/Services/OrganizationOptionsApiClient.cs, and src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web/Components/Pages/Admin/ProductManagement.razor to restore routed-body visibility, make the shared user-header handler safe during prerender and local guardrail runs, keep shell org-option reads from failing hard when the API is unavailable, and wire the product dialog for deterministic Playwright focus and cleanup-friendly selectors.

Added tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright/ProductAdministrationWorkflowTests.cs and refined tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright/SmokeTests.cs so the initial representative slice now covers browser-driven product-availability toggling plus the add-product validation and keyboard workflow, while keeping the home-page smoke assertion scoped to routed content inside the main shell.

Fixed src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api/Controllers/ProductsController.cs to return a stable created-product response, then used the new Playwright helpers and workflow tests to verify product availability and creation through API readback, restore the sentinel product state, and archive automation-owned debug product rows after the run.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln, the focused Playwright workflow slice for ProductAdministrationWorkflowTests, and the full dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln suite. The final build succeeded with the existing preview-SDK notice, and the final full test run passed across AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright, and the repo test projects after the Session 2 fixes.

Ran the mandatory external session verification against the final Session 2 code state after the last low-risk cleanups, using the Session 2 spec excerpt, final modified file contents, and the successful build/test evidence, then saved the raw round-2 verifier output and received a VERIFIED verdict.
